response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced, versatile software craftsman with strong web, backend, and DLang expertise, but he lacks recent, substantive C++ experience (only a brief 6-month stint in 2014-2015) and no evidence of the required industrial-automation, IEC 62443 security, message-broker/MQTT, or IoT domain experience. His career has been overwhelmingly focused on web/TypeScript/Node.js stacks rather than the C++/embedded/industrial systems this role demands, making him a poor technical fit despite his seniority and strong engineering fundamentals.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering experience across multiple domains
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development)
Demonstrated ability to learn and work across many languages and technology stacks
concerns: Minimal, dated C++ experience (only ~6 months, over a decade ago) with no STL/OOP architecture depth shown
No demonstrated experience with IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity standards
No evidence of message brokers, MQTT, REST-based IoT systems, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
